explanation.en: “the finished work is ready to collect a week after the party” → C. In D the children also keep something (socks), but on the day, and they did not make it.

explanation.ru: «the finished work is ready to collect a week after the party» → C. В D дети тоже что-то уносят (носки), но в тот же день, и сделали их не они.

explanation.en: “Farm parties run from April to October only” → B: there are no farm parties from November to March.

explanation.ru: «Farm parties run from April to October only» → B: с ноября по март праздников на ферме нет.

explanation.en: “You are welcome to bring your own food and birthday cake” → B. C gives no food either, but it suggests a caterer, not your own food.

explanation.ru: «You are welcome to bring your own food and birthday cake» → B. В C еды тоже нет, но там советуют кейтеринг, а не свою еду.

explanation.en: “a lifeguard stays with the group from start to finish” → A. The coach in D only leads the warm-up games.

explanation.ru: «a lifeguard stays with the group from start to finish» → A: спасатель рядом всё время. Тренер в D ведёт только разминку.

explanation.ru: «Every child needs a form signed by a parent or carer» → D: письменное согласие взрослого на каждого ребёнка.

explanation.en: The evening session, 7.30–9.30, is two hours, and the day sessions also “last two hours” → FALSE: they are the same length.

explanation.ru: Вечерний сеанс 7.30–9.30 — два часа, и дневные тоже «last two hours» → FALSE: длина одинаковая.

explanation.en: “these closures are shown on our website at least a week in advance” → TRUE: closures are announced beforehand.

explanation.ru: «these closures are shown on our website at least a week in advance» → TRUE: о закрытии сообщают заранее.

RM-GT-S1-03-Q7.quote: these closures are shown on our website at least a week in advance

explanation.ru: «helmets may also be borrowed free of charge» → FALSE: шлем можно и купить, и взять бесплатно.

explanation.en: Gloves and helmets are sold at reception (“Both can be bought at the reception desk”); drinks are never mentioned → NOT GIVEN.

explanation.ru: На ресепшене продают перчатки и шлемы («Both can be bought at the reception desk»); о напитках ничего не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

explanation.en: “lost property is kept for one month” — we learn how long, not what happens afterwards → NOT GIVEN.

explanation.ru: «lost property is kept for one month» — сказано, сколько хранят вещи; что с ними потом, не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

explanation.en: “Everyone on the ice must wear gloves” → gloves. Helmets are only “strongly recommended”, and only for children.

explanation.ru: «Everyone on the ice must wear gloves» → gloves. Шлемы только «strongly recommended», и только детям.

RM-GT-S1-03-Q11.quote: Everyone on the ice must wear gloves

explanation.ru: «Children under eight must be accompanied on the ice by a paying adult» → a paying adult. «Seven or younger» — то же, что «under eight».

RM-GT-S1-03-Q12.quote: Children under eight must be accompanied on the ice by a paying adult

explanation.ru: «Group lessons for beginners take place on Sunday mornings» → Sunday mornings. Утро вторника — это закрытие катка на хоккей.
